name: toju
description: Toju — offline-first post-discharge patient monitoring PWA

scripts.dev:services: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev --workspace backend" "npm run dev --workspace frontend"

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace frontend && npm run build --workspace backend
